# firefox

Firefox (the default browser, super+return) with palette-colored browser chrome.

The profile has a fixed name: `profiles.ini` and `installs.ini` (linked) declare `~/.config/mozilla/firefox/default-release`, so `user.js` (enables `userChrome.css`) and `chrome/userChrome.css` are linked into it like any config, before Firefox first starts. Restart Firefox to see a new palette.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`firefox/packages`): `firefox`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/mozilla/firefox/default-release/chrome/userChrome.css`
- `~/.config/mozilla/firefox/default-release/user.js`
- `~/.config/mozilla/firefox/installs.ini`
- `~/.config/mozilla/firefox/profiles.ini`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `firefox/.config/mozilla/firefox/default-release/chrome/userChrome.css.tmpl` → `firefox/.config/mozilla/firefox/default-release/chrome/userChrome.css`: `accent`, `bg_desktop`, `bg_hover`, `bg_surface`, `bg_widget`, `border_hairline`, `border_inactive`, `fg_bright`, `fg_secondary`, `fg_text`, `name`, `selection_bg`, `selection_fg`, `slug`

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): ask for a restart when Firefox is running. Firefox reads userChrome.css only at startup, so a running browser keeps the old colors.
